annotations.title: Check what a wallet paid and what came back

description: Call this to see how a wallet has done on Bittensor entry fees. Give the coldkey, which is the SS58 address that pays the fees, and it returns every entry that wallet made in the last 30 days with the fee paid, what came back, the result and whether the entry is still being paid.

coldkey.description: The SS58 address of the wallet that pays the fees, about 48 characters starting with 5.

name: check_wallet
title: Check what a wallet paid and what came back
